subject: general
question: Which Mughal Emperor issued the Deccan campaign against the Marathas and spent significant time in the region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aurangzeb**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Aurangzeb**, the sixth Mughal emperor, launched an extensive Deccan campaign against the Marathas during his reign.
 
• The Deccan campaign began in 1681 and lasted for nearly 27 years, until Aurangzeb's death in 1707.
 
• Aurangzeb personally led the campaign and spent a significant portion of his later life in the Deccan region, managing military operations.
 
• The campaign aimed to suppress the Maratha resistance under Chhatrapati Shivaji and his successors, but faced prolonged challenges due to guerrilla warfare tactics employed by the Marathas.
 
• This prolonged campaign drained the Mughal empire’s resources and is considered a major factor leading to the decline of the Mughal empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guerrilla Warfare:**

 
 
• The Marathas, under leaders like Shivaji and his successors, employed guerrilla tactics to counter the Mughal forces effectively.
 
• These tactics included swift raids, ambushes, and retreating to strongholds in the rugged terrain of the Deccan.
 
 
 
• **Decline of Mughal Empire:**
 
 
• The prolonged Deccan campaign severely strained the financial and military resources of the Mughal empire.
 
• Aurangzeb's focus on military conquests led to neglect of administrative and economic stability, contributing to the empire's decline.
 
 
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji:**
 
 
• Shivaji was the founder of the Maratha Empire and a key figure in resisting Mughal expansion in the Deccan.
 
• He established a well-organized military and administrative system, which continued to challenge the Mughals after his death.
 
 
 
• **Aurangzeb’s Legacy:**
 
 
• Aurangzeb is known for his military campaigns, strict adherence to Islamic orthodoxy, and expansion of the Mughal empire to its greatest territorial extent.
 
• Despite his military successes, his reign marked the beginning of the decline of the Mughal empire due to overexpansion and resource depletion.
